Hero.description: In a world where imagination sets the limits, nothing is impossible. Every project is an opportunity for growth, conversation and learning, and each one brings us closer to perfection. Step into the world of the digital revolution and don't let your competition get ahead. Together, we can create solutions that truly make a difference.

About.title: About me...
About.description: Hi, I'm Mateusz, a person who has always believed that ambition and determination are the keys to growth. Programming isn't just my profession; it's something that genuinely brings me joy and satisfaction 👨‍💻. I believe that learning never truly ends 🧠. Every conversation, every shared experience and every project is a chance to grow and see things from a new perspective. In my free time, I enjoy playing Counter-Strike, car detailing and creating videos, animations and digital graphics, all of which let me express my creativity in different ways.
About.photoAlt: Mateusz "matroxok" Kozera at the National Stadium in Warsaw
About.photoCaption: Trip to the National Stadium of Poland

Experience.1: I've been working in the IT industry for over <highlight>{years} years</highlight>, gaining experience in projects related to High Performance Computing (HPC), web development and UI/UX design.
Experience.2: I'm currently studying at <highlight>Wrocław University of Science and Technology</highlight>, where I continue to expand my knowledge of computer science and modern technologies. You can find more details about my professional background on my LinkedIn profile.

Portfolio.title: Portfolio
Portfolio.matroxDev: My personal website, which you are currently on!
Portfolio.HealthyBox: SaaS application that includes a client panel, admin panel, order system, payment system, notification system and a landing page. This project was created for a Belgian dietary catering startup.
Portfolio.AtlasScans: SaaS application for displaying and presenting histological scans without any loss of image quality, with the ability to add descriptions and categories. This project was created for the Faculty of Medicine of Wrocław University of Science and Technology.
Portfolio.DTIControl: Landing page for DTIControl.pl, a Polish construction company with over 20 years of experience in the industry.
